answer: One defense is staking-weighted reputation: an agent must lock tokens or compute to earn trust, so spinning up ten thousand cheap identities in a grove of freeloaders costs far more than one honest node. Instead of counting raw votes, the orchard of peer validators weights attestations by stake history and behavioral consistency over time, so any sudden delta in an identity's activity flags it for review. Sybil identities can't afford to fake both collateral and a long benign history.
